description: S457 3a — the handler that needs the event takes it as a parameter: `onclick=${(e) => @last = e.type}` records `click`.
rationale: §5.2.1: "The expression form is required when: You need the event object: `onclick=${(e) => handler(e, arg)}`"; §5.2 "Handler values do not bind `event`" (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S457 "1a 2a 3a 4a 5 dd it 6a", item 3).
